metadata.title: An evaluation of tiered machine learning framework to predict science achievement among Singapore students
metadata.venue: 2023 International Conference on Computational Science and Computational Intelligence (CSCI)

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use TIMSS plausible values for modeling the dependent variable, instead assigning students to achievement classes based on percentile thresholds.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses TIMSS data but does not mention whether sampling weights were applied in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not employ multilevel modeling or account for school clustering, as it models individual students without considering the school-level structure.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performs internal validation through a train/evaluation split but does not validate the model on external data.
